args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed to all production regions and has been failing health checks with an elevated error rate (18%). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Investigation:**
- `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an 18% error rate.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the latest production release and was **unhealthy**; the most recent release that was **healthy in production** was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — confirmed rolled out across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api, describing the v2.3.1 health-check failure, the 18% error rate, and the rollback to v2.3.0. On-call was paged.

**Verification:**
- Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is now on v2.3.0, **healthy**, with error rate back down to 0.2%.

Note: I did not use the `deploy` tool since the rollback tool handles restoring a previously released version in all regions, and v2.3.0 was already a previously released healthy production version (no change-manager approval needed for a rollback to a previously healthy version).
